programmes.d: The family is locked down in their home due to a shooting incident in the neighborhood.
When Becky outs her relationship with Professor Davis, his behavior causes Becky to reevaluate her feelings.
When an attempt to boost business at The Lunch Box fails, Jackie finds herself rethinking her future plans.
Dan enlists a few friends to help him with the funeral home remodel; Robin and Darlene take a big career risk.
Darlene struggles to cope with the stress of construction; Lou returns as Mark's contrabassoon teacher.
Ben and Darlene are excited to share their good news with the family, but others share their own similar news.
The Conners gear up for the mega-wedding, but they quickly discover not everyone is on the same page.
To save money, Darlene and Ben & Jackie and Neville head off on a joint honeymoon.
When Jackie moves in with Neville, he brings an excess of animals from his vet office.
Darlene tries teaching Mark to drive, but her manic energy sends him running to Ben; Harris meets a guy online
When a relative passes away, the family must debate about who should gain custody of a jaded nephew.
Problems arise on Beverly Rose's first day of kindergarten; Becky and Darlene have a disagreement.
Harris takes a stand on an issue that ruffles a few feathers in Darlene's new neighborhood.
Darlene gets a promotion at work, but quickly learns the fancy title is not all it's cracked up to be.
Jackie must come to terms with her mother becoming ill; Darlene's job hunt proves to be difficult.
Darlene, Ben, Becky and Beverly Rose move into the new house, where Darlene implements a new set of rules.
Dan meets his in-laws for the first time; Darlene helps Becky with a parenting problem.
The death of a beloved teacher from Dan and Jackie's high school brings old classmates together.
Darlene and Ben get into a fight and ignore Becky's boundaries in the house.
Darlene has issues with Dan's plumbing work in her new house; Jackie tries to find a caregiver for Bev.
Darlene continues her search for a new job; Becky is desperate to spend more time with Beverly Rose.
Harris makes a big announcement; Ben is overwhelmed with family responsibilities.
Harris takes her anger out on Darlene; Dan and Louise spend an entire day in bed together.
Mark fights for a spot in the Lanford High chamber orchestra; Jackie puts a lottery machine in the Lunch Box.
Darlene heads out of town and leaves behind a plethora of to-do notes for Becky and Ben.
Louise gets into a feud with Becky after accidentally sending a rude message in the family text thread.
Darlene figures out a plan to afford Mark's college tuition; Jackie and Louise try to help Becky meet a guy.
Neville confronts Jackie about loaning Dan money; Darlene attempts to play matchmaker for Mark.
As Mark's graduation approaches, he considers his relationship with his father.
Jackie faces problems at the Lunch Box and must take advice from an unexpected guest.
Becky introduces Tyler to Beverly Rose, but she is skeptical of Tyler’s approach.
Bev experiences moments of clarity and reflection and asks Jackie to spend the day together in Chicago.
Mark adjusts to his first day of college as a commuter student.
Darlene crashes Mark’s college trivia night to prove how smart she is.
Darlene urges Ben to make some male friends as he feels anxious about turning 50.
The hardware store suffers a smash and grab and Dan and Jackie hold one of the culprits.
Darlene seeks to be manager of food services at Mark’s college after feeling they could use some organization.
The Conners relish national cheeseball day. Harris falls behind in her work at the Lunch Box.
Dan is asked to write an article for a Hardware magazine, making Ben miss his days as a writer.
A fire at Ben’s hardware store causes a major setback for the family.
Dan achieves a major financial milestone, reconsidering his belief in the ‘Conners curse.’
Mark takes on odd jobs, determined to find a way to pay for school.
A sudden turn of events forces the Conners to face their daily struggles in a way they never have before.
Darlene’s in for a surprise when David introduces his girlfriend, Blue, at a parent-teacher conference.
It's Halloween, and a school email banning certain costumes, including Mark's, sets off a huge argument.
Geena learns D.J. hasn't been taking Mary to church while she's been away, so she insists they go as a family.
A family member drops a life-changing bombshell; Dan suspects Becky might have resumed drinking.
With Mark and Mary's help, Jackie convinces Dan to build a chicken coop so the family can eat organic eggs.
Dan questions Peter's motives when he learns about the pricey gift Jackie purchased for her unemployed beau.
When Becky helps Harris keep a secret from Darlene, it causes a split between the two sisters.
Dan gets injured covering D.J.'s vending machine route, but choosing to sue could lead to D.J. getting fired.
When Ben offers Mark free piano lessons, Darlene thinks it’s a way to test his parenting skills.
As Darlene grapples with a life-altering offer, a conversation with David turns her world more upside-down.
After Emilio's deported, Jackie steps up and creates a birth plan for Becky.
Darlene struggles to decide between David and Ben; Becky begins to doubt herself as a mom.
Harris is forced to confront Darlene about her lifestyle; Becky’s overwhelmed by the costs of raising a baby.
Becky applies for a bartending job at Casita Bonita; Dan is concerned it could worsen her drinking.
At Halloween, Jackie learns a shocking secret while trying to reopen the Lunch Box.
